[package]
name = "mathml2latex"
description = "Converts MathML into LaTeX"
authors = ["Haydn Trowell"]
version = "0.1.0"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
edition = "2024"
repository = "https://github.com/haydntrowell/mathml2latex"

[dependencies]
roxmltree = "0.20"
once_cell = "1"
regex = "1"

[dependencies.phf]
version = "0.11"
features = ["macros"]
